title: Unleash Your AI Agent's Inner Scorsese: Introducing `ffmpeg-skill` for Local Video Editing!
article: Hey fellow developers! Ever wished your super-smart AI coding assistant could do more than just write code? Imagine if it could also edit videos, tweak audio, and add captions – all without uploading your precious footage to the cloud. Well, prepare to have your mind blown, because I just stumbled upon a GitHub project that makes this a reality: `ffmpeg-skill`! This project is an absolute game-changer. It's an 'Agent Skill' designed to empower AI agents like Claude Code, Cursor, or even Codex, with robust video editing capabilities. The magic? It hooks into your *local* FFmpeg installation. That's right, no cloud processing, no external API keys, just pure, powerful, on-device video manipulation. It teaches your agent a fixed, intelligent workflow: first, it probes the video to understand it, then it edits losslessly where possible, checks its own output, and finally verifies the results. This isn't just a simple wrapper; it comes packed with *42 specialized tools*! Think about it: cutting, joining, removing silence, reframing aspect ratios, adding animated captions and karaoke effects, overlays, HDR to SDR conversion, audio cleanup, loudness normalization, and even multi-cam sync. The demos alone are incredible, showing before-and-after transformations like animated captions or perfectly reframed videos, all generated by simple commands. It's like giving your AI agent a professional video editing suite, right there on your machine. The benefits for us developers are huge. Firstly, *privacy and security*. Since everything runs locally, your sensitive footage never leaves your machine. This is a massive win for projects dealing with confidential content. Secondly, *workflow automation*. Imagine an AI agent not just generating code for your video app, but also automatically preparing and optimizing the video assets themselves! Need to quickly create social media clips from a longer recording? Your agent can now do it. Want to normalize audio across a batch of interviews? Easy. The project also boasts a brilliant `SPEC` (Self-Producing Execution Contract) feature, where each tool's input schema is derived directly from its `argparse` parser. This means the machine-readable contract is always up-to-date with the CLI flags, making it incredibly robust and easy for agents to understand and use. It's built with Python standard library, making it highly accessible and easy to integrate. If you have FFmpeg and Python 3 on your PATH, you're good to go. This is a fantastic leap forward in how we can leverage AI for creative and production tasks, saving countless hours and opening up new possibilities. Seriously, go check it out!
key_takeaways: `ffmpeg-skill` empowers AI agents with local, privacy-focused video editing.
It uses your existing FFmpeg installation, requiring no cloud or API keys.
Comes with 42 powerful tools for tasks like cutting, captions, audio cleanup, and more.
Automates complex video workflows, enhancing developer productivity and creativity.
Features a self-producing execution contract (`SPEC`) for robust agent integration.
readme_summary: ffmpeg-skill provides a local, offline video editing environment for AI coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor. It offers 42 FFmpeg-based tools accessible via a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, enabling agents to perform tasks such as cutting, adding captions, reframing, and loudness normalization without relying on cloud services or API keys.
description: Local video editor for coding agents: 42 FFmpeg tools with a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Cut, captions, reframe, loudness, platform exports. No cloud, no API keys.
